title: The Firelight Lightbox WordPress plugin before 2.3.23 does not escape the URL of links it opens in its Classic…
description: The Firelight Lightbox WordPress plugin versions prior to 2.3.23 do not properly escape URLs in links opened by its Classic lightbox feature. This vulnerability allows users with Contributor-level permissions to inject stored cross-site scripting (XSS) payloads that execute when other users click crafted links.
